messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Get emergency medical help if you have signs of an allergic reaction to allopurinol.
Signs of an allergic reaction to allopurinol include hives, difficult breathing, and swelling in your face or throat.
Get emergency medical help if you have a severe skin reaction.
Signs of a severe skin reaction include fever, sore throat, burning eyes, skin pain, and a red or purple skin rash with blistering and peeling.
Seek medical treatment if you have a serious drug reaction that can affect many parts of your body.
Symptoms may include skin rash, fever, swollen glands, muscle aches, severe weakness, unusual bruising, or yellowing of your skin or eyes.
Allopurinol may cause serious side effects.
Stop using this medicine and call your doctor at once if you have:
any skin rash, no matter how mild;
painful urination, blood in the urine;
inflammation of your blood vessels - numbness or tingling, skin rash, fever, headache, body aches, night sweats, weight loss, feeling or weak or tired;
Triplet: ["allopurinol", "has symptom of serious side effect", "severe weakness"]

The relation 'has symptom of serious side effect' in the triplet is defined as 'An occurrence of the serious side effect caused by the subject drug may present with the symptom specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'has overdose symptom': An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
C. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
D. 'has reporting information': The subject drug has information available for reporting side effects or adverse events to the entity specified by the object.
E. 'has overdose risk': An overdose of the subject drug may result in the serious or life-threatening consequence specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
